recipes.name: The Sloppy Jessica inspired by Brooklyn Nine-Nine
ingredients: 1 1/2 canned chipotles in adobo (depending on heat preference)
instructions: Begin by toasting your ancho chilis until they just barely start to smoke and then place in boiling water for 10 minutes. - Ancho chilis (3 4 depending on size)

In a blender add the chilis and water along with cumin, ground coriander seed, paprika, and canned chipotles in adobo sauce (more or less depending on your heat preference) and blend together. - 2 tsp cumin - 2 tsp ground coriander - 2 tsp paprika - 1 ½ canned chipotles in adobo (depending on heat preference)

In a pan, brown ground beef. Once browned, remove from the pan. Put a chopped onion and minced garlic into the pan to cook in the beef fat. Once fragrant and translucent, add ancho chili mixture, diced tomatoes, and the ground beef. Stir to combine, season with salt and pepper, and set aside. - 1 lb ground beef - 1 small onion diced - 2 cloves of garlic - 1 can diced tomatoes - Salt - Pepper
Cook ziti noodles in a large pot. Once cooked, drain pasta and set aside. - 1 box ziti noodles

In the same pot whisk together flour and butter. Once combined, slowly add whole milk. Mix and scrape sides until everything is fully combined. Also add ground mustard and a little bit of hot sauce. - 3 tbsp butter - 3 tbsp flour - 3 cups of whole milk - 1 tbsp Dried mustard - Hot sauce
Add grated yellow cheddar cheese along with grated parmesan cheese and mix until fully melted and combined. - 1 lb grated yellow cheddar cheese - 4 ½ ounces of grated parmesan
Add the pasta to the mix and stir until fully combined. Season with salt and pepper and set aside. - Salt - Pepper

In a pan, heat some olive oil before adding small chopped onion and cook for a few minutes until soft and translucent. Add garlic and cook briefly. - Olive oil - 1 small diced onion - 1 ½ cloves of garlic

Add a 50:50 mix of diced and pureed tomatoes along with a few pinches of dried oregano and sprig of basil. Simmer for 45 minutes to an hour or until mixture has slightly thickened. - 1 can pureed tomatoes - 1 can diced tomatoes - Dried oregano - 1 sprig of basil
Season with salt and pepper, and set aside. - Salt - Pepper
For the Assembling the Sloppy Jessica
Cut french bread in half lengthwise. Add mozzarella cheese on both halves, topped with the red sauce, more mozzarella and some grated parmesan.
Place in a 425°F oven until cheese is melted.
Combine your mac and cheese with your chili and mix together to make chili mac.
Remove french bread from oven and top with chili mac mixture.
Fold bread in half to make sandwich. Cut in half. Serve and enjoy!
